svg.title: Four-level workflow for checking a suspicious SMS link
svg.desc: A defensive workflow progresses from preserving and parsing a message, through independent brand verification and passive checks, to isolated retrieval reserved for trained and authorised analysts.
svg.text: PROPORTIONATE ANALYSIS / STOP AT THE LOWEST SUFFICIENT LEVEL
Most recipients need Levels 1–2. Levels 3–4 add privacy and operational risk, so they require a reason and a boundary.

g.text: LEVEL
Preserve and parse offline
Save the message, sender, time and screenshot. Copy only if safe, defang, then separate host, path and query.
NO NETWORK CONTACT · NO PUBLIC SUBMISSION · KEEP THE ORIGINAL
LEVEL
Verify independently
Open the official app, type the known site yourself or call a verified number. Check whether the claimed event exists.
DO NOT REPLY · DO NOT USE THE MESSAGE LINK OR PHONE NUMBER
LEVEL
Use passive context with a privacy check
Inspect public registration, DNS, certificate and reputation context without fetching the page. Record timestamps and coverage.
A LOOKUP CAN DISCLOSE THE URL OR TOKEN · ABSENCE OF A HIT ≠ SAFE
LEVEL
Controlled retrieval — analysts only
Use an isolated, disposable environment with no personal session. Do not enter credentials, payment data or one-time codes.
AUTHORITY · ISOLATION · EGRESS CONTROL · EVIDENCE PRESERVATION · STOP CONDITION
NO EXPECTED EVENT
Report, block and delete after evidence is preserved.
DATA ENTERED OR APP INSTALLED
Move to incident response. Do not continue investigating.
